group.title: Revising a package
group.passage:
F1: We've received three complaints that the glass jars moved around inside their shipping boxes. None broke, but we shouldn't wait until that happens.
M1: The supplier recommends a thicker cardboard divider. It costs a little more, although it would fit our current boxes.
F1: Keeping the same box size matters. Our packing machine is already set up for it. Can we test a sample before placing a large order?
M1: A sample is arriving tomorrow. I'll pack six jars and send them through the normal delivery route to our warehouse.
F1: Good. Ask the warehouse team to photograph the contents before removing them.
M1: I'll do that. If the test goes well, we can introduce the dividers with next week's shipment.
group.passageZh:
女：我們收到三件客訴，玻璃罐在運送箱內晃動。沒有破裂，但不應等到破了才處理。
男：供應商建議用較厚的紙板隔板。成本略高，但可放進現在的箱子。
女：維持箱子尺寸很重要，包裝機已按此設定。大量訂購前能先測樣品嗎？
男：樣品明天到。我會包六罐，循平常配送路線寄到倉庫。
女：很好，請倉庫人員在取出物品之前拍攝內容物。
男：我會辦。如果測試順利，下週出貨就可採用。
